The '''Entrallan Senate''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Entralla/Legends|Entralla]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Entrallan Senate was placed under house arrest by the [[Pentastar Alignment]] after putting down a growing resistance on Entralla.
